desc:
🌙 Survive the night. Then survive what comes after. 💀

A pixel-art horde survival game. Your weapons attack on their own: you move, dodge and grow stronger as the dead pour in from every side.

🏹 14 monster hunters, each with their own weapon, perk and looks
💎 Build your loadout from 21 weapons and 15 relics
✨ Max a weapon with its partner relic, then open a chest to evolve it
👹 Five bosses before dawn across 9 hunting grounds
🔥 Modifiers for harder hunts and bigger rewards
🛡️ Equipment and reforges
🤝 Hunt with up to 3 friends
🏆 61 achievements and kill leaderboards
🎁 Daily rewards
👍 Like + join the group for Sable, the Crow Keeper

🦇 Survive a full Nightmare hunt to unlock Vesper, the Nightmare Knight.

⏳ How long can you last?
